resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO (plane-wave pseudopotential DFT code with SOC+U) or equivalent open-source DFT code

access.notes: Use the PWscf package with spin-orbit coupling and Hubbard U correction (lda_plus_u). Any other open-source DFT code capable of LDA+U+SO (e.g., ELK) may also be used.

resources.name: Cubic lattice parameters for bcc Np, fcc Pu, Am, Cm

access.notes: Provided as crystal_lattice_parameters.json in the task resources. Contains the lattice constants a (in Å) for the cubic phases of the four metals at ambient pressure.
